name: Inline dynamic tools
description: Sandboxed JS tools with inline bodies (no network).

dynamic_tools.name: json_pretty_print
dynamic_tools.body:
const parsed = JSON.parse(args.text);
return { ok: true, formatted: JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2) };

dynamic_tools.name: word_count
dynamic_tools.body:
const words = String(args.text).trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
return { ok: true, count: words.length, words };

dynamic_tools.name: clamp_number
dynamic_tools.description: Clamp a number between min and max.
dynamic_tools.body:
const v = Math.min(args.max, Math.max(args.min, args.value));
return { ok: true, value: v };
